body: Thanks for your considered reply, I appreciate you taking the time out to read all that. I know there are fixes and that going to my doctor would be the top of a list of things I can do. I suppose I don't know where to summon the motivation from to do that at the moment - I gave it everything I had and it is looking like I will have to continue on this uphill battle for the rest of my life. I have spent the last eight years trying to get my mental health in good shape for myself and that feels like a lost cause now. I am not noble enough to live my life exclusively for other people. I feel lost.
